verdict.rationale: Letta documents a default local mode where agent state, including memory, stays on your machine with no Letta login, plus a self-hosted App Server on infrastructure you control. The evidence never shows the agent running against local models, and models are framed as Claude/GPT/Gemini via BYOK. Shared memory repositories are hosted in Letta Cloud, so a fully cloud-free setup is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: documented local-model (on-device inference) support, evidence of truly in-process embedded memory, a local alternative to cloud-hosted shared memory, and independent hands-on corroboration of offline operation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the memory layer fully locally — embedded in-process or against local models — without any cloud dependency

citations.quote: This default local mode stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login.
all agent state, including messages, memory, and provider connections, stays on-device, and no Letta account is required.
Letta agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control
Each shared memory repository is a Git repository hosted in Letta Cloud
